Google 4.3 con 3,238 reseñas e Instagram 43.8K verificados en vivo 2026-11-06. Citas de WeddingWire (2009-2015, antiguas) de Downloads/avinu-venues-investigacion-ronda2-2026-11-05.md. NO se usan las cifras totales de sq ft de la web (20,000 vs 36,000: contradictorias). Kosher NO afirmado como oferta propia (la web solo dice 'specialized options available for kosher gatherings'). Fotos 'pool-ceremony' (miasb-wedding) y 'canopy-ceremony' (rcsobch_00203): lugar exacto no confirmado, van con texto generico. Salon 1-3 y Courtyard no tienen foto confirmada: no llevan tarjeta, solo cifras en la nota. Salon 2/3: 'up to 360' (maximo del schema de la web; la tabla de bodas da 358/342 en recepcion). Videos: reels de @ritzcarltonsouthbeach bajados por el usuario (2026-11-06), sin audio, PENDIENTE permiso: hotel/piscina (portada movil), Lapidus Bar y DiLido (carrusel de cocina). Descartados: lobby y vista al mar (texto encima), champan ('More bubbly please'), playa con niños, habitacion, cafe y taller de cocteles (no son de eventos).

seo.title: The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach · Weddings, Events & Galas
seo.description: Weddings, social celebrations, galas and corporate events at The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach, an Art Deco landmark on Lincoln Road with a 10,212-square-foot ballroom for up to 1,075 guests. Music, lighting and production by Avinu Events.

hero.kicker: Miami Beach, Florida · Art Deco landmark
hero.lead: An Art Deco landmark overlooking the beach: a ballroom under blue Baccarat chandeliers, ocean-view terraces and room for up to 1,075 guests.

paras: Designed by Morris Lapidus and opened as The DiLido Hotel in 1953, The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach sits on the beach at 1 Lincoln Road, with Atlantic views, a classic ballroom and open-air venues.
Weddings and events are led by a dedicated Catering and Sales team, with menus that reflect Miami’s diverse culinary scene and a hotel that welcomes Jewish and Indian celebrations.

items.title: Weddings
items.text: Sharing vows amid the swaying palm trees, a lavish reception where the dance floor and glasses are always full, and an ocean-view cocktail hour in between.

spaces.h2: The Ballroom, the Gallery and the beach
spaces.text: A grand ballroom, event rooms, a beachfront club and open-air terraces, all in one landmark hotel.

items.name: The Ritz-Carlton Ballroom
items.text: 10,212 sq ft with blue Baccarat chandeliers, for ceremonies and receptions: 840 seated for banquet, 1,075 reception, 1,000 theater.

items.name: The Gallery
items.text: A flexible room, used for cocktail receptions.

items.name: DiLido Beach Club South
items.text: Views of the Atlantic and miles of white sandy beach in a lush lounge setting, for a cocktail reception, brunch or rehearsal dinner.

items.name: The Venetian
items.text: One of the hotel’s smaller rooms, for seated meals and private gatherings.

spaces.note: Capacities from the hotel’s official table: Salon 1, 3,552 sq ft (280 banquet, 372 reception); Salons 2 and 3, 3,404 and 3,256 sq ft (up to 360 each); Outdoor Courtyard, 3,312 sq ft (240 banquet, 350 reception, 370 theater). Confirm layouts with the hotel’s Catering and Sales team.

cuisine.h2: Globally inspired dining by José Andrés Group
paras: The hotel’s restaurants and bars, Zaytinya, Lapidus Bar and DiLido Beach Bar, are run by José Andrés Group, with poolside receptions on Zaytinya’s terrace and beachfront events at DiLido Beach Bar.
Customized catering features the bold flavors of Miami, with banquet menus that reflect the city’s diverse culinary scene.

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Miami Beach to Boca Raton: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
production.lighting: Uplighting and dance-floor lighting for the Ballroom’s chandeliers and ceilings, and sound designed for each ceremony and cocktail space, within the hotel’s guidelines.
